scope: Existing Outcomes Beginner only; source edition and IDs retained

pedagogy.manualSourceComparison: Source-control candidates inspected across all 12 units; remaining typing classified by instruction and sampled by unit. Not a claim of manually re-authoring all tasks.

reasonDefinitions.writing-spelling: Own writing, spelling, correction, or production of a grammatical form; no supplied final-form bank.
reasonDefinitions.independent-retrieval: Recall or extract an answer from the recording, reading or picture; a final-answer bank would change this objective.

typing.classificationMethod: Instruction-based categories, with manual source checks of choice/bank/order candidates and representative exceptions in all 12 units. Counts are independently checked against mounted DOM controls.
